summary: Independently reviewed six incoming dependencies and four ownership overlaps; no directed pair added or withdrawn. Refreshed screening covers 217 active roadmaps in the 218-roadmap, 2007-stage snapshot. Corrected baseline reuse, distinguished planned DG/exact-functor adapters from existing foundations, and checked the two outgoing relationships already recorded in partner packets. Accepted as a link map, not as implementation or a proof audit of every roadmap theorem.

provenance.verificationScope: Roadmap contracts, not implementation or independent proof review. Original source ledger preserved in PR #538 and the handoff.

links.reason: Import the exact-category foundation: genuine Quillen exact structures, admissible squares, opposites and conflation-exact functors. Core carriers, relative predicates, enoughness and the Frobenius-exact predicate already exist at the pinned Tau Ceti commit. R-RELATIVE now requests documentation alignment and any genuinely missing transport API, not duplicate definitions. No general exact-derived category is imported.

links.reviewNote: For a degree-r homogeneous right-linear f, delta(f)=d_N f-(-1)^r f d_M has delta^2(f)=d_N^2 f-f d_M^2. At common right curvature w this is f(m)w-f(mw)=0. This validates enrichment, not square-zero differentials on the curved objects. The DG-category package is a planned supplier export.
